name: braid-based protein-folding operator
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

braid-based protein-folding operator

phase_0.boundary_condition: the folded protein conformation sealed within the braid operator
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: directed transformation of the chain toward a folded target

AREV.justification: reverse descent transformation unwinding a crossing

CLINK.justification: sequential chaining of morphisms into a single folding operator

ENGAGR.justification: both T and F held at once when a crossing both stabilizes and destabilizes

EVALF.justification: constructive falsity F where the braid crossing destabilizes the fold

EVALT.justification: constructive truth T where the braid crossing stabilizes the fold

FFUSE.justification: the arms rejoin into a single resolved state over SIXTEEN_3

FSPLIT.justification: one state opens into two arms: forward fold and reverse unfold

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only fixation of the folded state

IMSCRIB.justification: self-reference where the element is itself and leaves the chain unchanged

TANCH.justification: the terminal anchor that contains the complete folded system

VINIT.justification: the void state before any folding operation is named

phase_2.fuse_result: single resolved folding state over SIXTEEN_3
phase_2.rejoin_note: the forward arm applies AFWD crossings while the reverse arm applies AREV crossings; conflicting results rejoin to B, and the fork closes into one verdict
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: unfolded polypeptide chain enters the braid operator uninitialized
folding decision point opens into forward fold and reverse unfold arms
forward fold arm applies braid crossings that stabilize the conformation
forward morphism drives the chain toward the native folded target
reverse unfold arm applies braid crossings that destabilize the conformation
reverse descent morphism unwinds crossings back toward the unfolded state
contradictory folding state holds both stabilization and destabilization at once
resolved folding verdict rejoins the forward and reverse arms into one B4 state
composition of adjacent braid crossings chains the folding morphisms into a single operator
identity braid leaves the chain unchanged as a neutral self-reference
native folded conformation anchors the terminal boundary of the system
locked native conformation fixes the folded state permanently and irreversibly

phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical braid word serves as the bootstrap store for folding operators
phase_5.compiler_frontend: translates braid crossing specifications into IMASM folding operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: braid strands communicate through crossing events and shared folding states
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the polypeptide chain stores folding state in its spatial configuration
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the order of braid crossings determines the folding trajectory and timing

phase_6.cycle_cost: free energy consumed per braid crossing operation cycle
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the braid operator redistributes entropy between the chain and its environment without net creation or destruction
phase_6.post_cycle_state: folded protein conformation with reduced conformational entropy
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: unfolded polypeptide chain with high conformational entropy
